items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What do you think of Sarah Vaughn and Ella Fitzgerald? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I think that they're both . Ella Fitzgerald's sister used to stay with me. ... They're all right.

ctx.x: How do you -- you were talking about the Pearl Bailey show you saw on TV. Do you remember Ella Fitzgerald and Sarah Vaughn were on that show with her for a few minutes. Did you see that?
